extracted.intended_audience: PR professionals, marketing teams, agency and in-house communications teams, brand managers, and analysts
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for choosing or building PR report templates to track media coverage, campaign performance, and present insights clearly to stakeholders. Covers template features, reporting cadence, collaboration, and visualization needs for agencies and in-house teams.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clear data points
rubrics_metrics.description: Choose a template that isolates key metrics to allow for quick comprehension of campaign impact, avoiding information overload.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The template should highlight the most important numbers rather than dumping all raw data—this enables stakeholders to understand impact at a glance and prevents reports from becoming overwhelming. Use isolated, prominent fields for core KPIs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Concise overview
rubrics_metrics.description: Prioritize a quarterly or monthly PR report template that delivers a summary upfront to enable stakeholders to grasp the essential findings without wading through excessive detail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Start reports with an executive summary or key takeaways tailored to the reporting cadence (monthly/quarterly) so busy readers can quickly see wins, issues, and recommended next steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive media coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: Select a template with relevant clippings and top publications. This provides tangible evidence of your campaign’s reach and placement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include screenshots, publication names, logos, and direct quotes or links to coverage; group by tier or relevance to show breadth and quality of placements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social media analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Pick a PR report template that includes a section that captures social posts and showcases engagement and sentiment trends, which is crucial for understanding the public’s perception.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Capture social mentions, engagement metrics (likes, shares, comments), and sentiment over time; use trend charts to show shifts and correlate social activity with earned media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Goal alignment
rubrics_metrics.description: Easily customizable to track progress against specific campaign objectives and KPIs, not just generic metrics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Templates should allow mapping metrics to campaign goals (awareness, consideration, conversions, etc.) so results demonstrate progress versus stated objectives rather than raw counts alone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internal team collaboration
rubrics_metrics.description: Opt for a PR report template that makes it easy to share feedback among internal teams for better collective understanding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include comment or review fields, assignment/ownership markers, and versioning or approval workflows so stakeholders can collaborate on the report before distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quantifiable results
rubrics_metrics.description: Use PR report templates that include a section to highlight the most mentions and other measurable outcomes, demonstrating the tangible impact of your PR efforts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlight top metrics (total mentions, reach, impressions, AVE or advertising-value-equivalency if used) and tie them to business outcomes where possible; avoid unquantified claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Structured messaging fields (press release template)
rubrics_metrics.description: Press release templates include fields for headlines, quotes, distribution plans, and media contact details to optimize messaging and streamline creation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide clear, labeled fields for headline, subhead, lead paragraph, boilerplate, quotes, and media contact info so writers and reviewers can populate and iterate consistently.

rubrics_metrics.name: Approval workflow and internal feedback tracking
rubrics_metrics.description: Track internal feedback, edits, and approvals directly in the workspace to keep review cycles organized.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Templates should support assigning collaborators to specific sections, tracking approvals, and showing edit history so press releases and reports move through sign-off efficiently.

rubrics_metrics.name: Launch and distribution scheduling
rubrics_metrics.description: Set launch and distribution deadlines with built-in reminders and task automation to coordinate timing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include fields or calendar integrations for embargo times, distribution lists, and automated reminders so teams can manage release timing and follow-ups reliably.

rubrics_metrics.name: Campaign consolidation and cross-channel KPI visualization
rubrics_metrics.description: Consolidate campaign data to measure key metrics across multiple channels and visualize KPIs and performance metrics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aggregate data from email, social, paid ads, and earned media into unified charts and tables to show PR contribution to broader marketing results; use visuals for comparisons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data sync and automation
rubrics_metrics.description: Sync data from different ClickUp tasks and campaigns for accurate reporting and automate reporting workflows with AI-powered insights and automations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Automated data pulls, scheduled report generation, and AI summarization reduce manual compilation time and keep reports current; validate automated sources to ensure accuracy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project progress and status tracking
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a high-level overview of KPIs and help project managers monitor task completion rates and pending action items in one place.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include status indicators, task lists, timelines, and milestone tracking so project- or campaign-level reporting can feed into executive reports without starting from scratch.

rubrics_metrics.name: Executive-summary and audience tailoring
rubrics_metrics.description: Highlight key insights in a clear, structured format—customize summaries based on audience (client-facing, internal, or C-level).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design separate blocks or versions of the report for different stakeholders, focusing on strategic implications for executives and tactical details for operational teams.

rubrics_metrics.name: Performance reporting sections
rubrics_metrics.description: Include structured sections for goals, benchmarks, KPIs, sentiment scores, earned media results, reach, engagement data, and outcomes to present campaign impact with precision.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use consistent section headers (e.g., Goals, Benchmarks, Results, Insights, Next Steps) and populate with comparable metrics and narrative analysis to surface learnings and recommended actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dashboards and multiple dynamic views
rubrics_metrics.description: Build visual dashboards with multiple views like Gantt, Workload, and Calendar for a dynamic reporting experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide interactive dashboards and alternative views so different users can explore timelines, resource allocation, or campaign performance as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media outreach tracker and centralized media database
rubrics_metrics.description: Use a media outreach tracker to maintain a centralized database of journalists and media contacts and to track every pitch’s journey from 'Draft' to 'Published'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track pitch status, contact history, and outcomes per journalist to measure outreach effectiveness and reduce duplicate outreach. Include custom statuses and labels for workflow clarity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customizable formatting and branding
rubrics_metrics.description: Customize fully with editable text, logos, and company details to match your brand and replace default images with campaign-relevant visuals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Templates should allow easy insertion of brand assets, custom colors, and layouts so outputs are stakeholder-ready and consistent with corporate identity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Visual and interactive reporting elements
rubrics_metrics.description: Use visuals, charts, drag-and-drop modules, infographics, and clip pages to make complex data easier to digest and present results engagingly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage screenshots, graphics, and interactive modules to illustrate coverage highlights, viral moments, and trendlines; arrange content to support narrative flow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Benchmarking and comparative analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Compare performance against benchmarks and industry standards to contextualize results and show relative success.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include competitor or historical benchmarks where possible and call out deviations from expected performance to inform strategy adjustments.

rubrics_metrics.name: CSR and PR integration
rubrics_metrics.description: Blend PR outcomes with CSR performance, offering a structured layout to showcase impact-driven storytelling and connect PR messaging with brand responsibility efforts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When relevant, include sections linking PR activity to CSR initiatives, using visuals and metrics to demonstrate social impact alongside media results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Archive-ready and shareable outputs
rubrics_metrics.description: Produce polished, shareable formats (PDFs, web-based reports, slide decks) that are suitable for client updates, stakeholder sharing, and archival.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure templates export cleanly to common formats and are organized for long-term storage or stakeholder distribution without extra formatting work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Product-launch-specific reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: For launch campaigns, include product milestones, feedback, and results in visual timelines to present a go-to-market recap effectively.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Capture milestones, pre-launch activity, launch-day coverage, and post-launch sentiment and engagement to evaluate launch performance comprehensively.

rubrics_metrics.name: Narrative focus—tell a compelling story
rubrics_metrics.description: An effective PR report template goes beyond simple data logging; it helps tell the story of your PR impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combine metrics with interpretation, highlights, and recommended next steps so the report communicates strategic value rather than just numbers.
